results.rationale: All eleven mandatory M0 content files now require lower-case SHA-256 digests in a signed dictionary and an equal checksum table. Missing or extra entries, malformed digests/maps, duplicate checksum rows and invalid UTF-8 reject before digest-selected paths can be read. Read failures reject without fabricating integrity. Complete packs from the existing compiler remain accepted; eleven separately omitted/re-signed contents that previously passed now fail.

source_checks.observation: Fixed M0 content coverage includes all mandatory contents, excluding only three self-referential verification artifacts; digest values must be lower-case hex64.
Strict UTF-8/checksum entry validation, duplicate/path rejection, exact table/envelope equality and actual content hash comparison.

guards: Coverage is for the fixed M0 content layout; additional file digests are rejected rather than interpreted as arbitrary read paths. A future layout extension needs an explicit verifier contract.
The signature continues to be checked against the public key supplied in existing metadata; this patch does not establish an independent identity trust anchor.
No hostile concurrent pack mutation or symlink-safe snapshot guarantee is claimed. Integrity concerns the bytes read by the existing verifier in owned fixtures.

The three verification metadata artifacts are excluded from recursive content hashing to avoid self-reference; checksum bytes are signed via their digest and the envelope/signature are independently checked.

Existing C0177 / V04 JSON integrity handling is unchanged: round2 test_v04_payload_hash_must_commit_content, test_v04_invalid_json_shape_rejected and test_v04_hash_only_scope_is_explicit pass in the 115-test related suite. CRL compatibility is covered separately by the v03 regressions.
results.runtime_scope: Owned temporary M0 packs, real SQLite and real Ed25519 fixture signatures; disposable HOME and blocked TCP/DNS.

preserved_findings.basis: V04 JSON content-integrity verification is unchanged by the M0 coverage patch. The existing round2 V04 payload-tampering, invalid-shape and explicitly hash-only-scope tests all pass within the related suite.
